Light & Calm · iPhone and iPad

One gesture.
A little light.
A moment for you.

Launch a ball of light into a bioluminescent forest and let it wander. Every bounce becomes a note. Every journey leaves something beautiful behind.

Discover Lucentia   ↓

Little worlds of music. No account needed.

A forest that plays along

Let the light lead the way.

Drag, release, and watch. Mushrooms, crystals and flowers turn each bounce into music that follows the harmony of the moment.

01 / WANDER

Your pace. Your atmosphere.

Choose Guided, Balanced or Free, then see the forest in Rain of Light, Starry Night, Aurora or Dawn.

02 / LISTEN

A world made of sound.

Discover music tuned to 432 Hz and optional binaural soundscapes: Rest, Focus or Sleep. Enjoy binaural beats with headphones.

03 / KEEP

A painting of your journey.

Listen to your melody again, add a title and dedication, and save your trail in the Herbarium of Light. Or share it as an image.

Night mode

Set it down. Let it glow.

Choose a duration and let new journeys begin on their own. The music gently fades, and the session ends when the time is up.

Binaural beats are a sound experience, not a treatment.
